trigger: Control room, after the black-start minigame succeeds.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The turbine spins up. A deep, rising hum. Then the control room lights flicker on.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Listen to her. Hah. Listen to that.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Okay, kid. One feeder's good. One. Where's it go?

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: ma. it worked. he... he'd have liked that sound.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: one line, right? that's what he said. where does it go?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Feeder 3 can reach: Lakehead Memorial, the ore docks, or the DECC and the rail signals.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: Hospital keeps maybe 80 people alive. Docks feed three thousand. DECC runs everything else.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Nobody answers. The hum fills the room.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Twenty miles away, an ICU wakes up. Ames gets on the radio and says nothing for ten seconds.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: 'Fridges,' he says finally. 'Your son's insulin has a fridge. For as long as you keep this on.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The elevator lights come on over the docks. People cheer you can't hear.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Bea, on the radio: 'Show of hands, everybody who loves Dell. That's all of them.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The DECC lights up. Strand's comms come back. So does her link to Saint Paul. And beyond.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: That night, for the first time, the Authority talks to Washington. Washington talks back.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The plant hums. For one night, nobody in the room is cold.
